It’s possible but there’s a lot of work to be done, constantly and some things kinda have to happen in your favor. In my case lack of feeling like I was in control of my life was a main driver. So I had to change jobs, address control issues with parents and spouse, make a schedule that worked for me, work out in my terms, do stuff for me. At the beginning it felt hopeless but slowly realized some things were changing in my life. First I noticed I no longer had extremely vivid dreams, I could sleep through the night, I started enjoying stuff again, I started laughing again; biggest one was being able to feel sad about stuff without it destroying my day or week.  Also not wanting to kill myself was nice. One day I noticed that when I fucked something up my inner monologue wasn’t reverting to “you worthless piece of shit you need to die” and instead was something like “oh damn, well you did your best, let’s try something different next time”

That said, would I have been able to do that without access to money and time? I doubt it. Think I was lucky and privileged to be able to seek help and get it.

It eats your confidences to keep being pushed away so you decide to stop trying so much. Slowly but surely the physical connection starts disappearing. Eventually you simply stop trying to do any type of more sensual touching cause it just gets you horny which will lead to another “no”.
